Kokugakuin pages whose P958 sections look wrong

Report only — no edits, no QuickStatements. The correct section can only be read off the Kokugakuin page itself, which is how page 181621's values were established. This narrows where to look; it never guesses what the value should be.

Identity is (P13677 + section P958). Neither 0 nor n/a carries uniqueness, so a holder whose only section is one of those is not distinguished from its siblings.

900 Kokugakuin ids are held by more than one item, and 619 of them are fine. Nothing collides — nowhere do two items claim the same (id, real section). The failure mode is under-specification, not two shrines fighting over one entry.
